address: 10 avenue du Luberon (place de la Libération), Goult, 84220, France
bio: Facing the church on Goult's main square, this restaurant offers excellent Provençal-inspired cuisine with the odd contemporary twist. Tables are set up in a small dining area with modern decor and out on the terrace, where you can soak up the village atmosphere. A charming welcome and a well-devised wine list that pays particular attention to organic options. A lovely spot....
